hero.title: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker
hero.subtitle: An enterprise-grade WordPress plugin that turns raw merchant URLs into clean, branded, trackable links hosted on your own domain with conditional routing, Smart ToS uncloaking, GA-style local analytics, and Stripe payment integration.

status.title: Development Status: 100% Feature Complete (v1.0.0)
status.subtitle: Enterprise-grade WordPress plugin · Conditional routing · Smart ToS uncloaking · Click analytics & Stripe • WP 6.0+ · PHP 8.0+
status.description: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker is engineered by Lead Software Architect Abu Saeed Sayem at VibePress Studio. Each cloaked link is a WordPress custom post type (salc_link) with top-priority rewrite rules (^go/{slug}), 24h transient caching, bot-filtered local click tracking (wp_salc_clicks), and automated compliance layers.
status.rolloutStatus: The free edition has been submitted for WordPress.org plugin directory manual review, and the PRO edition is fully packaged.
rolloutSteps: Phase 1: Upon review approval, the Free edition goes live on WordPress.org for millions of publishers.
Phase 2: The PRO edition officially launches within one month featuring Keyword Auto-Linker, Health Scanner, Geolocation Routing, and Split Testing.

whyUseful.title: Why is Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker Essential?
whyUseful.subtitle: Solving long intimidating URLs, click abandonment, search engine penalties, and merchant compliance risks.

items.title: Trust & Click-Through
items.desc: Branded yourdomain.com/go/... links signal ownership, improve CTR in newsletters, YouTube descriptions, and social bios, and survive link shortener bans.

items.title: SEO Safety
items.desc: Automatically injects rel="nofollow sponsored" + target="_blank", sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow on every redirect, and adds Disallow: /go/ in robots.txt.

items.title: Compliance by Default
items.desc: Smart ToS Uncloaking detects amazon.* and amzn.to URLs, rendering raw destination URLs on frontend while beacon-tracking clicks (compliant with Amazon Associates §6). FTC Auto-Disclosure inserts an accessible <aside role="note"> banner.

items.title: Attribution You Control
items.desc: UTM/gclid/fbclid/wbraid parameter forwarding, per-visitor geo/OS/device routing, split-test variants, and local health monitoring on your server with zero SaaS lock-in (wp_salc_clicks + CSV export).

items.title: Operations at Scale
items.desc: Automatic deal expiration (date or max clicks -> 302 fallback or 410 page), nightly HEAD link health scanner, DOM-safe keyword auto-linking, and 1-click migration from PrettyLinks/ThirstyAffiliates/CSV.

useCases.title: All Possible Use Cases
useCases.subtitle: Versatile workflows tailored for review publishers, deal aggregators, newsletter operators, SaaS reviewers, creators, and multi-site agencies.

items.title: Amazon Review Site
items.desc: Cloak most links; Amazon domains auto-uncloaked for compliance, beacon still counts clicks; FTC disclosure auto-injected; health scanner catches dead ASINs.

items.title: Coupon / Deal Aggregator
items.desc: Create salc_link per deal, set expiration date + fallback URL (302) or max clicks cap; showcase grid widget displays popular deals; nightly health email finds dead coupons.

items.title: Newsletter & Paid Traffic
items.desc: UTM allowlist (utm_source, utm_campaign, gclid, fbclid, wbraid) forwarded intact to merchant for your analytics; split-test 2 destinations via weighted random.

items.title: SaaS Comparison Site
items.desc: One slug, multiple conditional destinations (OS=macOS -> mac landing, Android -> Play Store, Country=DE -> localized offer) via ConditionalRouter.php + GeoResolver.php.

items.title: YouTube / Podcast Show Notes
items.desc: Short memorable go/toolname links easy to speak; QR-ready; iFrame mask 200 option embeds merchant with sticky branded bar gradient #0058be->#ffb95f.

items.title: Course / Membership Upsell
items.desc: Stripe Checkout per-link (StripeClient.php) — go/course-checkout -> Stripe price_... session, webhook logs conversions (_salc_stripe_conversions).

items.title: SEO Content at Scale
items.desc: Keyword Auto-Linker (KeywordLinker.php) converts 'best vpn' -> cloaked link everywhere, DOM-safe (skips h1-h6, code, existing <a>), capped per-post/per-keyword.

items.title: Agency / Multi-site
items.desc: Categories aff_category organize by client/vertical; CSV round-trip for bulk ops; Search & Replace converts legacy raw URLs to [af_link id=] shortcodes.

items.title: Migration from PrettyLinks/ThirstyAffiliates
items.desc: One-click Tools -> Migration copies titles, destinations, click counts, preserving slugs where possible.

items.title: Compliance-First Publisher
items.desc: Combination: Smart ToS ON + FTC disclosure callout + GDPR anonymize ON + robots.txt block — publish without legal review per post.

organizational.title: Coupon/Deal & Comparison Sites
organizational.desc: Manage hundreds of expiring links; need bulk CSV import/export, expiration fallbacks, nightly health scans, and showcase grids.

organizational.title: Marketing Agencies & Publishers
organizational.desc: Manage client portfolios with Categories & Tags, CSV round-trip, Search & Replace, and GDPR IP anonymization ON for EU clients.

personal.title: Content Marketers & Newsletter Operators
personal.desc: Need branded short links that preserve UTM parameters for analytics and work offline (print/QR).

personal.title: SaaS Review & 'Best X' Publishers
personal.desc: Need conditional routing by geo/device and split testing without external redirector SaaS fees.

personal.title: Course / Membership Creators Selling via Stripe

freeItems.title: Custom Post Type & Permalinks (salc_link)
freeItems.desc: Title holds link name; slug becomes URL path (^go/{slug}). Menu icon Link-Shield SVG encoded as data URI.

freeItems.title: Redirect Engine (301 / 302 / 307 / 200 iFrame)
freeItems.desc: Handles 301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found, 307 Temporary Redirect (default, uncached), and 200 iFrame Mask with branded gradient bar.

freeItems.title: Smart ToS Uncloaking (Amazon §6)
freeItems.desc: Regex detects amazon.* and amzn.to, rendering raw destination URL on frontend while beacon-tracking clicks via navigator.sendBeacon.

freeItems.title: GA-Style Local Click Analytics
freeItems.desc: Records to local DB table wp_salc_clicks with bot filtering (30+ signatures), GDPR IPv4/IPv6 anonymization, Cloudflare geo, 7 Chart.js charts, and CSV export.

freeItems.title: FTC Auto-Disclosure Injector
freeItems.desc: Auto-inserts accessible <aside role="note"> disclosure banner in top, bottom, or before_first_link with 4 visual styles (Callout, Badge, Minimal, Subtle).

freeItems.title: SEO & Crawler Controls
freeItems.desc: Applies rel="nofollow sponsored" + target="_blank", sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive header, and adds Disallow: /go/ in robots.txt.

proItems.title: DOM-Safe Keyword Auto-Linker
proItems.desc: DOMDocument + XPath regex converts keywords to cloaked links everywhere, skipping h1-h6, code, pre, script, and existing <a> tags with per-post & global caps.

proItems.title: Conditional Routing (Geo, OS, Device, Language)
proItems.desc: Route visitors dynamically by OS (macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, Linux), Browser, Device, Language, and Country (GeoIP / Cloudflare CF-IPCountry).

proItems.title: Stripe Payment Links Integration
proItems.desc: Direct go/checkout -> Stripe Checkout Session creation via Stripe API. REST webhook (salc/v1/stripe-webhook) tracks revenue and conversion count.

proItems.title: Deal Expiration & Health Scanner
proItems.desc: Auto-expire links by date or click cap -> 302 fallback or 410 page. Nightly HEAD batch 20 health scanner tests destination URLs and emails broken link reports.

proItems.title: A/B Split Testing & Rotation
proItems.desc: Rotate traffic between multiple destination URLs using weighted random (mt_rand) or sequential rotation with variant click tracking.

proItems.title: Dynamic UTM & Query Forwarding
proItems.desc: Allowlist forwarding for utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, gclid, fbclid, msclkid, wbraid, gbraid while preserving destination parameters.

userGuide.title: Step-by-Step User Installation & Setup Guide
userGuide.subtitle: Complete walkthrough to install, configure links, setup conditional routing, enable FTC disclosures, and activate Stripe payment links.

steps: Upload ZIP via WP Admin -> Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin (or unzip smart-affiliate-link-cloaker to /wp-content/plugins/).
Activate plugin. Activator.php creates wp_salc_clicks table, seeds global settings, and schedules daily 02:00 UTC health check.
Go to Affiliate Links -> Settings. Confirm Global Prefix (go), Anonymize IP (ON), Smart ToS (ON), and Default HTTP Redirect (307). Click Save.
Go to Settings -> Permalinks and click Save Changes (no edits) to register RewriteEngine rules.
Navigate to Affiliate Links -> Add New Link.
Enter Title (e.g. 'Best VPN Deal') and Target Destination URL (e.g. https://merchant.com/?aff_id=123).
Select Redirect Type (307 Temporary Recommended) and toggle rel="nofollow / sponsored".
Assign Categories & Tags (aff_category / aff_tag) and click Publish.
Conditional Routing: Add rules based on OS (macOS -> Mac offer), Device (Mobile -> App Store), or Country (DE -> German landing).
Stripe Payment: Enter Stripe Secret Key sk_live_... & Webhook Secret in Settings. Toggle Enable Stripe on link metabox and enter Price ID.
Keyword Auto-Linker: Go to Settings -> Auto-Linker, set max limits per post, and add keyword-to-link mapping rules.
Deal Expiration: Set UTC expiration datetime or click cap, fallback URL (302 redirect), or expired message (410 page).
Go to Settings -> FTC Disclosure. Choose position (before_first_link, top, bottom) and style (Callout, Badge, Minimal, Subtle).
Verify Smart ToS Uncloaking: Test an Amazon URL. Raw link renders on frontend while beacon tracks clicks via navigator.sendBeacon -> POST salc/v1/track.
Go to Affiliate Links -> Statistics to inspect real-time click charts, device breakdown, top performing links, and export CSV.
